matching_source: owner-corrected source GT union to frozen detector boxes; geometry/cardinality/coverage then detector confidence
GT_source: derived owner corrections; no original masks modified
scope: exact 90 frame packets per model; selected annotated parts only
GT_Neck_missing_policy: pending/null, never an all-zero Neck or model-dependent ignore
primary: mean of per-GT-part IoU within each target, then mean across four targets; null while Face/Neck GT incomplete
valid_domain_non_Face: whole original-image grid of the matched person plane; unannotated targets excluded as tasks, never crop predictions to GT bbox
FaceDomain: whole grid minus own GT Neck and GT-only uncertainty; requires explicit reviewed annotation
FaceNeck: GT Face union own Neck; only GT uncertainty ignored
NeckCoverage: candidate recall on reviewed GT Neck; null for zero/unknown support
Dress_Apparel: OTHER; no splitting or per-model ignore
missed_GT_person: empty target masks, GT-positive part IoU zero
zero_union: null; absence is not a positive annotated part
